scope.parent_data_exposure_limit: The frozen parent/C5 system has seen these DEV-prefix TRAIN24 scenes; these 24 are not an independent deployment test.

method.band_summary: 100-Hz ready event action, raw 10-ms target, reference acceleration, position error, and surface; Hann Welch nperseg=1024 (df=0.09765625 Hz), 50% overlap; per-scene PSD integration.
method.coherence: Welch magnitude-squared coherence within each band; flagged unusable as a separation signal if reference-acceleration band RMS < 5% of action RMS. Same-trajectory action/target coherence is descriptive only.
method.tone_sensitivity: For offline scene-spec frequencies only: compare 20-s full-window sinusoid+trend fit, Hann-weighted fit, Welch local band RMS (f +/- 0.12 Hz), and a Hann fit after subtracting a zero-phase 0.5-Hz low-pass reference trend. The low-pass residual is an offline decomposition, not a deployable input.
method.tone_residual_limit: The 0.5-Hz low-pass residual deliberately removes reference content at/below 0.5 Hz; it is not used to judge the W00-W02 .25/.45-Hz reference lines.
method.derivative_consistency: Relative RMS between 1-kHz finite differences of reference position/velocity and logged reference velocity/acceleration, excluding 5 ms at record edges.
method.causal_filter_response_example: Fourth-order Butterworth causal high-pass residual branch at 0.5 Hz, fs=100 Hz; response example only, not a proposed candidate or proof of 0-.5-Hz identity.

key_interpretation.reference_tone_boundary_leakage: Unwindowed finite-record tone regression can assign slow reference trajectory/edge content to a high-frequency sinusoid. On W09, the full-window position tone at 2.2 Hz is ~1e-2 m while Hann/residual fits are orders smaller; raw 1-kHz derivatives are mutually consistent, so the full-fit value is not a trustworthy high-frequency reference component.
key_interpretation.position_target_conflict: The 10-ms target and C5 action share strong same-trajectory narrowband structure in the active wind bands. Fitting that target can reward the very wind-frequency compensation whose attitude effect is under dispute.
key_interpretation.reference_separation: Reference coherence at bands where reference acceleration power is below 5% of C5 action power is retained only as a raw descriptive number; it is not an identifiable deployment gate. Action-target coherence is same-trajectory and is not a causal action effect.
key_interpretation.counterfactual_limit: No same-scene alternative action exists in this audit; no frequency decomposition or frozen replay identifies closed-loop Q_m or task_SO3 under a changed action.

minimal_paired_closed_loop_plan.baseline: exact C5 DSSM14 position + cosineGRU attitude; pair on same scene ID, initial state, reference, morphology schedule, and deterministic wind phase; reuse an existing C5 or B run only after full runner/source identity is bound

primary_anchor_scenes.purpose: low-frequency/reference-confound guard; do not shape below 0.5 Hz

interventions.application: One broad causal band at a time; other bands unity; same fixed bank across every scene; no W-code input; no exact notch; do not optimize gain on the held-out group.
interventions.paired_candidate_runs_for_minimum_screen: 12 active-band anchors x 2 gains + 3 low-frequency controls x 2 gains = 30 candidate runs, plus exact C5 and B baselines for the 15 treated contexts. W15 is identity/no-tone control and needs only an identity parity check.
interventions.expanded_screen: Use all 24 physical TRAIN_C5_24 scenes at both gains for the active broad band, adding the six non-anchor scenes; this estimates task/amplitude heterogeneity before fitting at most 4-6 global band parameters.

minimal_paired_closed_loop_plan.decision_rule: Proceed only if the paired dose response is directionally stable across tasks and amplitude levels, candidate task_SO3 is no worse than B, and position Q stays within the predeclared C5 non-inferiority margin. Mixed signs or a sharp task interaction reject a global band gain.
minimal_paired_closed_loop_plan.model_size: Do not train a new deep net from these 24 trajectories. At most fit 4-6 shared scalar gains (or a low-dimensional regularized response curve) after paired closed-loop labels exist; scene count, not event count, is the effective sample size. Group all folds by whole frequency/W stratum and report every paired scene.
minimal_paired_closed_loop_plan.not_identifiable_now: Existing C5 records contain only one closed-loop action per scene. Frequency correlation or frozen replay cannot identify the counterfactual Q_m or task_SO3 under a changed filter.
